body.construction: Begin from a least-conditioned unit vector \(h\perp\operatorname{col}(\Gamma)\), use the exact cohortwise inverse loading transform associated with the rank-one factor perturbation in direction \(ha_0^{\prime}\), and allocate primitive slack along the four-mask path \(z=19/5+\eta\) to seek alternatives remaining in the same prescribed shell while separating a missing coordinate.
